_about: Which policy clauses the recommender gives Claude to judge, and why. Reviewable by credit policy: every clause in a
result says which entry below brought it in. `pin` clauses go to every check; each trigger runs its searches only when
its `when` trait holds for the application (traits are computed in mrac/recommender.py from the profile and facts).
Searches are housing-filtered and reranked. The searches share the slots left after the pinned clauses by taking
turns (each search's best hit, then each one's second best, ...), so no trait crowds out another. A search hit is
skipped when its clause is in an `exclude_prefixes` section (not about evaluating a housing application), shorter
than `min_chars` (a bare heading), or scored below `min_rerank_score` by the reranker. Pinned clauses are never
filtered. More than `batch_size` clauses are judged in parallel Claude calls of about that size.

pin.label: Housing loan risk acceptance criteria and housing section (always checked)

_exclude_why.CPM-I..V, CPM-XV, CCD-I..III, RED-I..II: introduction, philosophy, strategy, risk spectrum, organisation, glossaries
_exclude_why.CPM-X, CPM-XI, CPM-XIII, RED-IX: portfolio limits, credit monitoring / past due, workout and remedial: after the loan
_exclude_why.CPM-XVII, CPM-XVIII, CPM-XX, CPM-XXI: business-loan risk rating, Ready Credit, environmental risk (ESRMS)
_exclude_why.CCD-V, CCD-VI, CCD-VIII, CCD-IX: auto, consumer, motor loans, service level agreement
